title: IndustrialKnowEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Level Industrial Knowledge in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.20695v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for industrial tasks, yet few benchmarks evaluate their mastery of industrial knowledge across different types of cognitive demand. We introduce IndustrialKnowEval (IndKnow), a benchmark for industrial knowledge and engineering question answering. It contains 43,282 samples covering 21 task types across seven industrial sectors, including aerospace, electric power, and metallurgy, organized into four levels of cognitive demand: memory, comprehension, reasoning, and engineering application. Enterprise-based domain specialists and experienced researchers participate in all stages of dataset construction and quality control. We conduct a series of experiments on 18 representative LLMs, with domain experts deeply involved in the evaluation. translated_title: IndustrialKnowEval：一个用于评估大语言模型多层次工业知识的基准
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在工业任务中的应用探索日益增多，但很少有基准能够评估其在不同类型认知需求下对工业知识的掌握程度。我们提出了 IndustrialKnowEval（IndKnow），一个面向工业知识与工程问答的基准。该基准包含 43,282 个样本，覆盖包括航空航天、电力和冶金在内的七个工业领域的 21 种任务类型，并按四个认知需求层次进行组织：记忆、理解、推理和工程应用。来自企业的领域专家和经验丰富的研究人员参与了数据集构建与质量控制的全过程。我们在 18 个代表性大语言模型上开展了一系列实验，领域专家深度参与了评估工作。基于 IndKnow，我们提出了工业认知能力差距（ICCG）指标，用于刻画基础模型与……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了覆盖七个工业领域、21 种任务类型，并按记忆、理解、推理和工程应用四个认知层次组织的工业知识问答基准 IndustrialKnowEval（IndKnow），同时提出 ICCG 指标来量化大语言模型的工业认知能力差距。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces IndustrialKnowEval (IndKnow), a benchmark with 43,282 samples across seven industrial sectors organized into four cognitive levels (memory, comprehension, reasoning, and engineering application) to evaluate LLMs' industrial knowledge, and proposes the ICCG metric to quantify the industrial cognitive capability gap.
